scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts
scripts.test: npm run format && npm run lint && npm run test:core && npm run test:server && npm run test:browser
scripts.lint: npm run lint:core && npm run lint:browser
scripts.lint:browser: cd native/swirldb-browser && cargo clippy --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix:core && npm run lint:fix:browser
scripts.lint:fix:browser: cd native/swirldb-browser && cargo clippy --fix --allow-dirty --allow-staged --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --all-features -- -D warnings
